name: Enojo
source:
"Are you asking me out?
I'd love to!"

Type: Humanoid Fox
He sometimes tricks you, but repays your kindness.

Favorites: girls

The hottest man among the four who appeared in front of you when mononokes attacked the castle.
Confident, selfish and mean. But you can rely on him when you get in trouble.
He is a sexy playboy, but sometimes seems lonely. Why?
